research_scope: New controllable video and animation capability demos; verified primary sources, not an unverified daily popularity ranking.

rounds.title_zh: 可拖拽、可倒放的机械拆解动画：技术选型与原理 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Seekable, reversible mechanical cutaways: a selection and first-principles FAQ
conclusions_zh: 把动画看作按时间查状态，拖拽与倒放就不会继承上一帧的误差。
零件中心排序不够：遮挡需要看实体分离面和真实投影重叠。
本例测试代码控制与交付体验，不把 AI 论文指标冒充本机神经模型实测。
conclusions_en: Query state by timestamp so seeking and reversal do not inherit prior-frame errors.
Component centers do not establish occlusion; use solid separation and projected overlap.
This tests code controls and delivery, not neural video claims borrowed from papers.

rounds.title_zh: 仰视、俯视与滚转不乱跳：重力参考相机选型与原理 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Stable pitch, poles and roll: a gravity-referenced camera selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 相机朝哪里看不等于完整朝向，滚转也必须进入控制契约。
固定世界向上的简化 lookAt 会丢失请求滚转；函数本身可通过完整 up 向量补足。
127 部件云台与镜头共享状态；本机代码误差和资源计数不是神经视频画质或机械认证。
conclusions_en: Pointing is not a complete orientation; roll belongs in the control contract.
The fixed-world-up lookAt baseline omits requested roll; the API can use a complete rolled up-vector.
The 127-part rig and camera share state; local code checks do not certify neural video quality or mechanics.

rounds.title_zh: 只改一个主体，不改坏整段镜头：稀疏三维排戏选型与原理 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Edit one subject without rewriting the shot: a sparse 3D blocking FAQ
conclusions_zh: 三维盒子不仅记录屏幕位置，还记录主体大小、朝向和深度。
只改 A 的深度，可改变遮挡且保持 B 的矩阵完全不变。
90 条代理射线的独立方法一致性，不是神经视频像素准确率或机器人安全认证。
conclusions_en: A 3D box carries dimensions, orientation and depth, not merely screen position.
Editing A changes occlusion while retaining B's matrix exactly.
Agreement on 90 proxy rays is not neural pixel accuracy or robot safety certification.

rounds.title_zh: 移动影响场，不重抽整个世界：程序化散布与稳定身份选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Move the field, not the whole world: stable procedural scattering FAQ
conclusions_zh: 放置与动画分层：影响场只改尺度，不重抽已有位置与身份。
两种采样器产生相同接受 ID；本机所测密度下网格索引反而更慢。
中心间距、GPU对象计数与真实碰撞或显存字节是不同指标。
conclusions_en: Separate placement from animation: field edits change scale, not positions or identities.
Both samplers return identical IDs; the tested grid implementation is slower here.
Center spacing and GPU object counts are not collision or memory-byte certification.

rounds.title_zh: AI 创作应留下可编辑场景：声明式关键帧与原子修改选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: AI authoring should leave editable scenes: keyframes and atomic changes FAQ
conclusions_zh: 声明式场景记录目标状态，不只记录不可追溯的按钮点击。
完整草稿校验后原子应用；无效关键帧保留最后有效场景。
71 实体工作台能局部改轨并往返导出，CPU 查找不是 MCP 或模型执行回执。
conclusions_en: Declarative scenes retain intended state, not merely opaque button logs.
Validate the complete draft before atomic application; rejected edits preserve valid state.
The 71-solid bench supports local edits and semantic round trips; CPU lookup is not an MCP or model receipt.

rounds.title_zh: 次级特效不应跟着当前源瞬移：出生变换与活跃时间窗选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Secondary effects should not teleport: birth-aware FX selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 出生位置与继承速度不能被当前喷嘴变换覆盖，否则旧液滴瞬移。
活跃窗口与完整历史返回同样事件，3600秒历史的500次CPU查询约0.593ms对30.015ms。
59实体工作台展示弹道事件，不把次级特效控制说成完整流体或商业软件实测。
conclusions_en: Birth transforms and inherited velocity must not become current-source transforms.
Windowed and full-history queries return identical events; the 3600s tier takes about 0.593 versus 30.015 ms per 500 CPU queries.
The 59-solid rig demonstrates ballistic event control, not complete fluids or commercial software performance.

rounds.title_zh: 只改指定时间窗，不改坏原片段：局部动作保留与逆运动学选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Edit the window without rewriting the clip: local motion preservation and IK FAQ
conclusions_zh: 局部动作编辑不是整段重生成，82个受保护窗外采样精确保留。
73实体双连杆保留2.2与1.6骨长，不靠拉伸去够目标。
生成迭代调度与片段时间掩码是两轴，本例不冒充Scheduled Inpainting推理。
conclusions_en: Local editing is not whole-clip regeneration; 82 protected outside samples remain exact.
The 73-solid arm reaches the target without stretching its 2.2/1.6 links.
Generation schedules and clip masks are different axes; no Scheduled Inpainting inference was run.

rounds.title_zh: 动画导出不能靠录屏运气：按帧索引的原生视频编码选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Animation export should not depend on screen-capture luck: native offline video FAQ
conclusions_zh: 按帧索引渲染再编码，不赌屏幕录制抓帧节奏。
真实1080p WebM含60帧、2秒与383787字节，原生解码及HTML播放已测。
预览、微秒编码时间戳与毫秒容器时间码是三套坐标，不把制作耗时当屏幕延迟。
conclusions_en: Render indexed scene times before encoding rather than relying on screen-capture cadence.
A real 1080p WebM has 60 frames, two seconds and 383787 bytes, verified by native decode and HTML playback.
Preview, microsecond codec timestamps and millisecond container timecodes are separate coordinates.
